jobs.title: Information Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

We are looking for a proactive and service-oriented IT Infrastructure & Network Support Specialist to support local infrastructure and network initiatives. In this role, you will act as the primary on-site contact for infrastructure projects, provide end-user support, and coordinate activities across internal teams, external providers, and project stakeholders. You will play a key role in ensuring reliable IT operations and modern workplace technologies.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as the local point of contact, supporting both technical and administrative activities.

• Support infrastructure projects, including IT Hardware Lifecycle.

• Provide day-to-day IT support to end users, ensuring timely issue resolution and a high level of customer satisfaction.

• Coordinate infrastructure-related activities between departments, network providers, and project stakeholders.

• Ensure the smooth operation, maintenance, of meeting rooms and customer experience center.

• Create, maintain, and update site, network, and infrastructure documentation.

• Support hardware deployments, installations, and workplace technology setups.

• Monitor and coordinate local IT activities to ensure successful project delivery and operational continuity.

• Contribute to the standardisation and continuous improvement of IT infrastructure and workplace technologies.
Requirements

• Completed education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

• Experience supporting IT infrastructure, networking, or workplace technology environments.

• Strong understanding of network connectivity, hardware deployment, and end-user support processes.

• Experience coordinating with multiple stakeholders, vendors, and service providers.

• Ability to manage several tasks simultaneously in a dynamic environment.

• Strong problem-solving and organisational skills.

• Excellent communication skills in English; German is an advantage.

• Customer-focused mindset with a hands-on approach.
What We Offer

• A varied role with a strong mix of infrastructure, project coordination, and user support responsibilities.

• Opportunity to work on modern IT and network transformation initiatives.

• Collaborative international environment with exposure to cross-functional teams.

• Professional development and learning opportunities.

• Flexible and hybrid working arrangements.

• Attractive compensation and benefits package.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining technical expertise with stakeholder coordination and wants to contribute to the successful delivery of infrastructure and network initiatives.

#LI-OS1

Who we are : We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

How we work : When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here .

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

Data Privacy : We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started.

Beware of Job Scams: Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as Siemens Healthineers recruiters/employees.  These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information.  If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site.

To all recruitment agencies : Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

jobs.title: UX Researcher
jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Ensures that validation and documentation acitivties are performed compliant with given standards for the development of medical devices and creates all artefacts defined by the usability engineering process.
Continously validates hypothesis and design decisions against the target user needs to ensure relevance of products and services.
We are seeking an experienced UX Researcher to support the development of innovative software and hardware solutions within radiation oncology. In this role, you will plan and conduct user research activities that drive product decisions, improve user experiences, and ensure safe and effective clinical workflows.

Key Responsibilities

• Plan and execute user research to evaluate and improve product designs.

• Conduct user interviews, task analyses, design reviews, and usability testing.

• Define research goals, questions, and hypotheses aligned with business and user needs.

• Translate research findings into actionable insights and recommendations.

• Communicate results, KPIs, and next steps to stakeholders.

• Collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, Design, and Clinical Experts.

• Ensure research activities and documentation comply with regulatory requirements, including IEC 62366-1.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of UX research processes and best practices.

• Build a deep understanding of customer needs, clinical workflows, and user behavior.

Requirements

• Master's degree in Psychology, Human Factors, Human-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Science, or a related field preferred.

• 5+ years of experience in UX research supporting software and/or hardware product development.

• Strong experience planning and conducting usability studies.

• Solid understanding of User-Centered Design methodologies.

• Experience in healthcare, medical devices, or other regulated industries is a plus.

• Knowledge of Agile development practices.

• Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methods.

• Ability to influence product decisions through data-driven insights.

• Experience working in cross-functional, fast-paced environments.

• Proven ability to deliver high-quality work and meet deadlines.

jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Quality Engineer to support the effective operation of the Quality Management System (QMS) through the management of controlled documentation, training processes, and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs). This role plays a key part in ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, maintaining inspection readiness, and driving quality system effectiveness across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and maintain controlled quality documents and records in accordance with internal procedures and regulatory requirements.

• Coordinate document creation, review, approval, revision, and archival activities within the electronic document management system.

• Monitor document lifecycle activities and ensure timely updates of controlled documents.

• Support users with document management processes and system-related inquiries.

• Ensure quality records are complete, accurate, traceable, and audit-ready.

• Coordinate quality training programs and monitor training compliance across the organization.

• Support the development and maintenance of training curricula and learning plans.

• Partner with process owners to ensure training requirements align with regulatory and procedural expectations.

• Promote awareness of quality system requirements and compliance obligations.

• Support the management of CAPAs, including action tracking, follow-up activities, and due date monitoring.

• Assist with quality investigations through the collection of documentation, records, and supporting evidence.

• Prepare quality metrics and reports related to investigations, CAPAs, and overall quality system performance.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Quality Management, Engineering, Life Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Experience in quality systems, document control, training management, CAPAs, or a related quality function.

• Knowledge of regulatory standards such as ISO 13485, MDR, and MDSAP.

• Familiarity with document control processes, records management, and training administration.

• Experience working in a regulated environment, preferably within healthcare, medical devices, or a similar industry.

• Strong process- and compliance-oriented mindset with attention to detail and accuracy.

• Excellent coordination, organization, and follow-up skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities while consistently delivering high-quality results.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively across functions.
